description: AgentWorkflow.__init__ currently takes only repo_root and builds its own GitScopeEngine from cwd. Add a git_engine parameter so the server can inject GitScopeEngine(repo_root=<pinned>). progress and finish must compute changed_files and workspace_fingerprint against the pinned root, and a non-git repo root must return E_SCOPE_GATE on a mutation rather than silently scoping to cwd. workspace_fingerprint byte reads run only on the worker thread.

preserves.behavior: Existing CLI agent behavior is unchanged while both interfaces coexist

work_units.evidence: Verified GitScopeEngine construction only in AgentWorkflow.__init__ and GitScopeEngine._find_repo_root fallback to cwd; all git work goes through GitScopeEngine instance
work_units.summary: Confirm every GitScopeEngine construction site and AgentWorkflow's current cwd dependence

work_units.evidence: Added git_engine injection param to AgentWorkflow.__init__, mutually exclusive with repo_root, threaded through self.git_engine (commit pending)
work_units.summary: Add the git_engine injection seam to AgentWorkflow and thread it through

work_units.evidence: Non-git repo_root now raises E_SCOPE_GATE via GitScopeEngine.changed_files/workspace_fingerprint on progress/finish
work_units.summary: Return E_SCOPE_GATE when the pinned repo root is not a git repository on a mutation
